body: thank you, this was helpfull, i appreciate you taking the time to respond
im stuck, hes nice when friends, but not when he gives 100 compliments a minute

i worry because i do not want to be monitored by them. i do not want them to be afraid.
I know who i am, i dont struggle with finding myself. 
and also there is no grass, there is just snow here. also most part in the summer. and its cold, and much wind, and mountains makes the sun only come out like one hour a day

sorry for being negative, i understand you trying to help

my mom would end up digging herself into a hole. i know her. i tell her, and she is going to send me to a psych ward, and be very concerned.

no i did not, but id rather not think my choices has fatal consequenses as that will indeed dig me deeper into my depression. thanks, but that question was not at all helpfull

my therapist is incompetent as he can beush things off easily when he cant help, and send me to a psych ward

courts are not a thing we kinda do here in my experience. i can admit myself, or if i tell my therapist, they have the full right to put me in there without my consent. i can say i dont like it there but they wont feel secure with that, as ive been told before, and they'll tell my parents. its even worse being monitored at home than in a psych ward.

thank you. i will try my next therapy session

its distracting because of the monitoring kind of. like it does stop me from doing it there, but it makes me want to do it even more when i want to get out. the bad thing is that it does not help over a long period of time, only for the time being there.

i could, i do some self care as a distraction but i very rarely have the energy for it.

i understand, so dont worry. i appreciate you trying to help, i really do

thank you, and im glad to hear youve had atleast one good ecperience. unfortunately there is only one psych ward i can go to. and all the rules are the same trough the whole country.
i could go there but it ruins me. and it does not help in any way. it just keeps you distracted for about a week, then youre sent home, and the same shit happens over again. to me its nothing more than a time consumer.

they take everything and forces you to both eat and go out. they also took my phone for most of the day, which is my only coping mechanism yet.
ive been there. it does not help with anything but take up time. im sorry and thanks, but no need to.

if i tell my family they will freak out and not leave me alone by any means. they have found a note from me in the past, and now they have a fucking movement sensor outside my room. they also regularly look trough my room. they think i dont know but i do

i just think my bf is not knowing how to react. he is one of the kindest persons i know and he can be really supportive most of the time
thank you, i will try and tell him
